Script.name: Mudlet base UI
Script.script:
-- Mudlet base UI: a small starter interface that adapts to whatever the game -- provides. Nothing is created until the game actually sends something: -- vitals gauges are built from GMCP character data (normalised across the -- dialects games speak, and only for the fields that exist), with the map and -- chat windows alongside them. Chat comes from gmcp.Comm.Channel.Text when -- the game offers it; for everything else, additive triggers capture the -- common chat-line shapes (tells, says, channels) shared by most games - so -- on a game with no GMCP at all the UI appears on the first chat line. -- Chat is sorted into All/Tells/Channels tabs, and the map pane shows a -- placeholder until the profile actually has map data. -- Type "baseui" for options; "baseui hide" removes it until "baseui show". BaseUI = BaseUI or {} BaseUI.gauges = BaseUI.gauges or {} BaseUI.usedGaugeSlots = BaseUI.usedGaugeSlots or 0 BaseUI.chatTriggerIds = BaseUI.chatTriggerIds or {} BaseUI.recentCaptures = BaseUI.recentCaptures or {} local settingsFile = getMudletHomeDir() .. "/base_ui_settings.lua" -- one dark theme for the whole dock; the accent appears only on section -- headers and the active chat tab so it stays an accent local theme = { accent = "#4fc1e9", bg = "#1b1e23", panel = "#14171c", border = "#3a4149", borderSoft = "#2b3138", text = "#e8eef4", textDim = "#96a0ab", font = "Ubuntu", } local layout = { mapHeader = { y = "0%", height = "3%" }, map = { y = "3.5%", height = "33.5%" }, chatHeader = { y = "38.5%", height = "3%" }, tabs = { y = "42.5%", height = "3.8%" }, chat = { y = "46.3%", height = "29.7%" }, gaugeSlots = { "78%", "83.5%", "89%", "94.5%" }, gaugeHeight = "4.5%", } local headerCss = string.format( [[background-color: transparent; border: 0px; border-bottom: 1px solid %s; padding-left: 2px;]], theme.borderSoft) local placeholderCss = string.format( [[background-color: %s; border: 1px solid %s; border-radius: 6px;]], theme.panel, theme.borderSoft) local tabCss = { active = string.format( [[background-color: #2b323b; border: 1px solid %s; border-bottom: 2px solid %s; border-top-left-radius: 4px; border-top-right-radius: 4px;]], theme.border, theme.accent), inactive = string.format( [[background-color: #1f242a; border: 1px solid %s; border-bottom: 2px solid %s; border-top-left-radius: 4px; border-top-right-radius: 4px;]], theme.borderSoft, theme.borderSoft), } -- every gauge shares one look: light-to-dark vertical gradient over a dark -- inset track, rounded corners, bold centered value text local function gaugeStyle(top, mid, deep) return string.format( [[background-color: QLinearGradient(x1: 0, y1: 0, x2: 0, y2: 1, stop: 0 %s, stop: 0.45 %s, stop: 1 %s); border: 1px solid rgba(0,0,0,60%%); border-radius: 5px;]], top, mid, deep) end local gaugeBack = string.format( [[background-color: QLinearGradient(x1: 0, y1: 0, x2: 0, y2: 1, stop: 0 #101317, stop: 1 #1d2126); border: 1px solid %s; border-radius: 5px;]], theme.border) local gaugeDefs = { hp = { front = gaugeStyle("#84dd7f", "#2f9e3f", "#1c6f28") }, mp = { front = gaugeStyle("#7fb8e5", "#2f6f9e", "#1c4a6f") }, xp = { front = gaugeStyle("#f2cf7a", "#c28f2c", "#8a6316") }, enemy = { front = gaugeStyle("#ef8f8f", "#b23a3a", "#7c2222") }, } -- GMCP vitals arrive in several dialects: lowercase namespaces, maxima inside -- the vitals message or in a separate Maxstats one, and varying key names. -- Every node listed here is scanned on each update (the gmcp table keeps the -- latest message per node, so currents and maxima merge naturally even when -- they arrive separately) - supporting another dialect is one more line local vitalsNodes = { { "Char", "Vitals" }, { "char", "vitals" }, { "Char", "Maxstats" }, { "char", "maxstats" }, { "Char", "Status" }, { "char", "status" }, } -- one row per gauge; current/max/percent list every key spelling observed in -- the wild. A percent key is a ready 0-100 value and needs no max: nl (IRE -- next-level percent) and tnlpct for xp, opponent_hp_pct and enemypct for -- enemy health. transient rows hide their gauge when the value goes away -- (the enemy died or was cleared). local vitalsStats = { { key = "hp", label = "HP", current = { "hp", "health" }, max = { "maxhp", "max_hp", "maxHp", "maxhealth", "max_health", "maxHealth" } }, { key = "mp", label = "MP", current = { "mp", "mana", "sp", "energy" }, max = { "maxmp", "max_mp", "maxMp", "maxmana", "max_mana", "maxMana", "maxsp", "max_sp", "maxSp", "maxenergy", "max_energy", "maxEnergy" } }, { key = "xp", label = "XP", percent = { "nl", "tnlpct" }, current = { "xp", "experience" }, max = { "maxxp", "max_xp", "maxXp", "maxexperience", "max_experience", "maxExperience" } }, { key = "enemy", label = "Enemy", transient = true, percent = { "opponent_hp_pct", "enemypct" } }, } local function gmcpNode(path) local node = gmcp for _, key in ipairs(path) do if type(node) ~= "table" then return nil end node = node[key] end if type(node) == "table" then return node end end -- some games send numbers as strings, hence the tonumber()s; nested -- cur/max tables (vitals.hp = { cur = 10, max = 20 }) are handled too local function statReading(sources, stat) local current, max, percent for _, source in ipairs(sources) do for _, name in ipairs(stat.percent or {}) do percent = percent or tonumber(source[name]) end for _, name in ipairs(stat.current or {}) do local value = source[name] if type(value) == "table" then current = current or tonumber(value.cur) max = max or tonumber(value.max) else current = current or tonumber(value) end end for _, name in ipairs(stat.max or {}) do max = max or tonumber(source[name]) end end return current, max, percent end -- generic chat capture for games without GMCP chat: trigger shapes most games -- share. Capture is additive - the matched line is copied into the chat window -- with its colours and never removed from the main one. -- a "[tag]", "(tag)" or "< tag |" prefix only counts as chat when its first -- word is a well-known channel name - extend this list to cover more games BaseUI.chatChannelNames = { chat = true, say = true, tell = true, tells = true, gtell = true, newbie = true, newbies = true, gossip = true, grats = true, gratz = true, congrats = true, ooc = true, ic = true, clan = true, guild = true, order = true, house = true, city = true, market = true, auction = true, trade = true, talk = true, ask = true, answer = true, question = true, questions = true, music = true, quote = true, roleplay = true, rp = true, imm = true, group = true, party = true, team = true, shout = true, yell = true, form = true, town = true, } -- entries with tagged = true capture a channel tag that must pass the list -- above; family routes a line into the Tells or Channels tab as well as All local chatPatterns = { { regex = [=[^\w[\w'-]* tells you\b[^,:]{0,30}(?::|,?\s*['"])]=], family = "tells" }, { regex = [=[^You tell [\w'-]+[^,:]{0,30}(?::|,?\s*['"])]=], family = "tells" }, { regex = [=[^You tell the (?:group|formation)\b]=], family = "tells" }, { regex = [=[^\w[\w'-]* whispers to you\b[^,:]{0,30}(?::|,?\s*['"])]=], family = "tells" }, { regex = [=[^\w[\w'-]* tells the (?:group|formation)\b]=], family = "tells" }, { regex = [=[^\w[\w'-]* (?:says|asks|exclaims)[^,:]{0,20},?\s*['"]]=] }, { regex = [=[^You (?:say|ask|exclaim)[^,:]{0,20},?\s*['"]]=] }, { regex = [=[^\w[\w'-]* (?:yells|shouts)[^,:]{0,20},?\s*['"]]=] }, { regex = [=[^You (?:yell|shout)[^,:]{0,20},?\s*['"]]=] }, { regex = [=[^\[([\w][\w -]{0,18})\]]=], tagged = true }, { regex = [=[^\(([\w -]{1,18})\)[:\s]]=], tagged = true }, { regex = [=[^< ?([\w -]{1,18}) ?\|]=], tagged = true }, } local chatTabs = { { key = "all", label = "All" }, { key = "tells", label = "Tells" }, { key = "channels", label = "Channels" }, } function BaseUI.routeChatLine(family) -- gmcpChat means the trigger layer is retired: killing a trigger does not -- stop it firing on lines from the batch already being processed -- several patterns can match the same line - copy it only once if BaseUI.gmcpChat or BaseUI.settings.hidden or getLineNumber() == BaseUI.lastChatLine then return end BaseUI.lastChatLine = getLineNumber() selectCurrentLine() copy() deselect() local firstBuild = not BaseUI.container BaseUI.build() if firstBuild then -- building resizes the main window, which can renumber lines; refresh the -- marker so other patterns matching this same line stay deduplicated BaseUI.lastChatLine = getLineNumber() end if not BaseUI.chats then return end BaseUI.chats.all:appendBuffer() BaseUI.noteChatActivity("all") if family and BaseUI.chats[family] then BaseUI.chats[family]:appendBuffer() BaseUI.noteChatActivity(family) end BaseUI.checkMapData() table.insert(BaseUI.recentCaptures, { text = line, time = getEpoch() }) if #BaseUI.recentCaptures > 10 then table.remove(BaseUI.recentCaptures, 1) end end function BaseUI.routeTaggedChatLine() local tag = matches[2]:match("(%S+)") if not tag then return end tag = tag:lower() if not BaseUI.chatChannelNames[tag] then return end local family = (tag == "tell" or tag == "tells" or tag == "gtell") and "tells" or "channels" BaseUI.routeChatLine(family) end function BaseUI.createChatTriggers() if BaseUI.settings.hidden or BaseUI.gmcpChat or next(BaseUI.chatTriggerIds) then return end for _, pattern in ipairs(chatPatterns) do local handler if pattern.tagged then handler = BaseUI.routeTaggedChatLine else local family = pattern.family handler = function() BaseUI.routeChatLine(family) end end table.insert(BaseUI.chatTriggerIds, tempRegexTrigger(pattern.regex, handler)) end end function BaseUI.killChatTriggers() for _, id in ipairs(BaseUI.chatTriggerIds) do killTrigger(id) end BaseUI.chatTriggerIds = {} end function BaseUI.loadSettings() BaseUI.settings = {} if io.exists(settingsFile) and not pcall(table.load, settingsFile, BaseUI.settings) then -- corrupted settings file - start over with the defaults BaseUI.settings = {} end end function BaseUI.saveSettings() table.save(settingsFile, BaseUI.settings) end function BaseUI.sectionHeader(name, text, spot) local label = Geyser.Label:new({ name = name, x = "0%", y = spot.y, width = "100%", height = spot.height, font = theme.font, fontSize = 9, fgColor = theme.accent, format = "lb", }, BaseUI.container) label:setStyleSheet(headerCss) label:echo(text:upper()) return label end function BaseUI.mapHasData() return next(getRooms()) ~= nil end function BaseUI.createMapper() BaseUI.map = Geyser.Mapper:new({ name = "BaseUI_map", x = "0%", y = layout.map.y, width = "100%", height = layout.map.height, }, BaseUI.container) end -- the embedded mapper shows a clipped "load or create a map" widget while the -- profile has no map data, so a placeholder holds its spot until the first -- room exists (made by a mapping script, a map download or a manual load). -- Cheap to poll: getRooms() stays empty right up until the swap happens. function BaseUI.checkMapData() if not BaseUI.container or BaseUI.map or BaseUI.settings.hidden then return end if not BaseUI.mapHasData() then return end if BaseUI.mapPlaceholder then BaseUI.mapPlaceholder:hide() end BaseUI.createMapper() end function BaseUI.build() if BaseUI.container then return end BaseUI.container = Adjustable.Container:new({ name = "BaseUI", x = "75%", y = "0%", width = "25%", height = "100%", attached = "right", titleText = "Mudlet UI", titleTxtColor = theme.text, adjLabelstyle = string.format("background-color: %s; border: 1px solid %s;", theme.bg, theme.border), buttonstyle = string.format( [[QLabel{ border-color: %s; background-color: %s; } QLabel::hover{ background-color: rgba(90,100,110,50%%); }]], theme.border, theme.bg), -- the container's own session persistence can restore a hidden, detached -- state that is impossible to bring back reliably - we persist the only -- choice that matters (hidden or not) ourselves autoLoad = false, autoSave = false, }) BaseUI.mapHeader = BaseUI.sectionHeader("BaseUI_map_header", "Map", layout.mapHeader) if BaseUI.mapHasData() then BaseUI.createMapper() else BaseUI.mapPlaceholder = Geyser.Label:new({ name = "BaseUI_map_placeholder", x = "0%", y = layout.map.y, width = "100%", height = layout.map.height, font = theme.font, fontSize = 10, fgColor = theme.textDim, format = "c", }, BaseUI.container) BaseUI.mapPlaceholder:setStyleSheet(placeholderCss) BaseUI.mapPlaceholder:echo("Your map will appear
here as you explore") end BaseUI.chatHeader = BaseUI.sectionHeader("BaseUI_chat_header", "Chat", layout.chatHeader) BaseUI.chats = {} BaseUI.chatTabLabels = {} BaseUI.unread = { all = 0, tells = 0, channels = 0 } BaseUI.activeChatTab = "all" local tabX = { "0%", "34%", "68%" } for i, tab in ipairs(chatTabs) do local label = Geyser.Label:new({ name = "BaseUI_tab_" .. tab.key, x = tabX[i], y = layout.tabs.y, width = "32%", height = layout.tabs.height, font = theme.font, fontSize = 9, format = "c", }, BaseUI.container) label:setClickCallback(BaseUI.selectChatTab, tab.key) BaseUI.chatTabLabels[tab.key] = label local console = Geyser.MiniConsole:new({ name = "BaseUI_chat_" .. tab.key, x = "0%", y = layout.chat.y, width = "100%", height = layout.chat.height, autoWrap = true, -- plain black so trigger-captured lines (which keep the main console's -- background colour) blend in seamlessly color = "black", fontSize = 10, }, BaseUI.container) BaseUI.chats[tab.key] = console if tab.key ~= "all" then console:hide() end end BaseUI.chat = BaseUI.chats.all BaseUI.refreshChatTabs() BaseUI.chats.all:decho("<150,158,167>Tells, says and channel chat from the game will be collected here.\n") -- the container remembers its own hidden/detached state from the previous -- session (it saves on exit) - our setting says it should be visible, so -- override whatever it restored if not BaseUI.settings.hidden then BaseUI.container:show() if not BaseUI.container.attached then BaseUI.container:attachToBorder("right") end end BaseUI.maybeAnnounce() end function BaseUI.refreshChatTabs() for _, tab in ipairs(chatTabs) do local label = BaseUI.chatTabLabels and BaseUI.chatTabLabels[tab.key] if label then local active = BaseUI.activeChatTab == tab.key label:setStyleSheet(active and tabCss.active or tabCss.inactive) local text = tab.label local unread = BaseUI.unread[tab.key] if unread > 0 and not active then text = string.format("%s (%d)", tab.label, math.min(unread, 99)) end label:echo(text, active and theme.text or theme.textDim) end end end function BaseUI.selectChatTab(key) if not BaseUI.chats or not BaseUI.chats[key] then return end BaseUI.activeChatTab = key BaseUI.unread[key] = 0 for _, tab in ipairs(chatTabs) do local console = BaseUI.chats[tab.key] if tab.key == key then console:show() else console:hide() end end BaseUI.refreshChatTabs() end function BaseUI.noteChatActivity(key) if key == BaseUI.activeChatTab then return end BaseUI.unread[key] = (BaseUI.unread[key] or 0) + 1 BaseUI.refreshChatTabs() end -- keep the created gauges in vitalsStats order and packed from the top, -- whatever order their data completed in (a percentage can be ready before -- the hp maxima have arrived) function BaseUI.layoutGauges() local index = 0 for _, stat in ipairs(vitalsStats) do local gauge = BaseUI.gauges[stat.key] if gauge then index = index + 1 gauge:move("0%", layout.gaugeSlots[index]) end end end function BaseUI.ensureGauge(key) local gauge = BaseUI.gauges[key] if gauge then return gauge end local slot = layout.gaugeSlots[BaseUI.usedGaugeSlots + 1] local def = gaugeDefs[key] if not slot or not def then return nil end BaseUI.usedGaugeSlots = BaseUI.usedGaugeSlots + 1 gauge = Geyser.Gauge:new({ name = "BaseUI_" .. key .. "_gauge", x = "0%", y = slot, width = "100%", height = layout.gaugeHeight, strict = true, font = theme.font, fontSize = 9, }, BaseUI.container) gauge:setStyleSheet(def.front, gaugeBack) gauge:setFgColor("white") gauge:setAlignment("center") BaseUI.gauges[key] = gauge BaseUI.layoutGauges() return gauge end function BaseUI.updateVitals() if BaseUI.settings.hidden then return end local sources = {} for _, path in ipairs(vitalsNodes) do local node = gmcpNode(path) if node then sources[#sources + 1] = node end end if not sources[1] then return end BaseUI.build() BaseUI.checkMapData() for _, stat in ipairs(vitalsStats) do -- a gauge is only painted once a full reading is known: either a ready -- percentage, or both a current and a max (maxima are never assumed, so -- a stat may wait for a Maxstats message) local current, max, percent = statReading(sources, stat) if percent and (percent < 0 or percent > 100) then percent = nil end if percent then local gauge = BaseUI.ensureGauge(stat.key) if gauge then gauge:setValue(percent, 100, string.format("%s %d%%", stat.label, math.floor(percent + 0.5))) if gauge.hidden then gauge:show() end end elseif current and max and max > 0 then local gauge = BaseUI.ensureGauge(stat.key) if gauge then gauge:setValue(current, max, string.format("%s %d/%d", stat.label, current, max)) if gauge.hidden then gauge:show() end end elseif stat.transient and BaseUI.gauges[stat.key] and not BaseUI.gauges[stat.key].hidden then BaseUI.gauges[stat.key]:hide() end end end function BaseUI.addChatMessage() local message = gmcp and gmcp.Comm and gmcp.Comm.Channel and gmcp.Comm.Channel.Text if type(message) ~= "table" or type(message.text) ~= "string" then return end -- the game sends chat over GMCP and usually echoes it as plain text too - -- retire the generic triggers for this session so lines are not captured twice BaseUI.gmcpChat = true BaseUI.killChatTriggers() if BaseUI.settings.hidden then return end BaseUI.build() -- the first GMCP messages race their own plain-text echoes: an echo can be -- trigger-captured moments before this handler learns the game speaks GMCP -- chat, so drop a message whose text was just captured as a line if next(BaseUI.recentCaptures) then local plain = message.text:gsub("\27%[[0-9;:]*m", "") local now = getEpoch() for i = #BaseUI.recentCaptures, 1, -1 do local capture = BaseUI.recentCaptures[i] if now - capture.time > 2 then table.remove(BaseUI.recentCaptures, i) elseif capture.text == plain then table.remove(BaseUI.recentCaptures, i) return end end end local text = ansi2decho(message.text) .. "\n" BaseUI.chats.all:decho(text) BaseUI.noteChatActivity("all") local channel = type(message.channel) == "string" and message.channel:lower() or "" local family = channel:find("tell", 1, true) and "tells" or "channels" BaseUI.chats[family]:decho(text) BaseUI.noteChatActivity(family) end -- ask the game to send channel text over GMCP (not all games do so unprompted) function BaseUI.enableChannelCapture(_, protocol) if protocol ~= "GMCP" or BaseUI.settings.hidden then return end gmod.enableModule("BaseUI", "Comm.Channel") end function BaseUI.maybeAnnounce() if BaseUI.settings.announced then return end -- respect the first-run UI tour: hold the introduction until it is done if mudlet and mudlet.uiTourPending then registerAnonymousEventHandler("sysUiTourFinished", "BaseUI.announce", true) return end BaseUI.announce() end function BaseUI.announce() if BaseUI.settings.announced then return end BaseUI.settings.announced = true BaseUI.saveSettings() cecho("\n[ Mudlet UI ] Built you a starter interface from what your game supports - health bars, map and chat.\n") cecho("[ Mudlet UI ] Drag its title bar to move it, right-click for options, or type baseui hide to remove it.\n") end function BaseUI.hide() BaseUI.settings.hidden = true BaseUI.saveSettings() BaseUI.killChatTriggers() if BaseUI.container then BaseUI.container:hide() BaseUI.container:adjustBorder() end cecho("\n[ Mudlet UI ] Hidden - type baseui show to bring it back.\n") end function BaseUI.show() BaseUI.settings.hidden = false BaseUI.saveSettings() if type(gmcp) == "table" and next(gmcp) then gmod.enableModule("BaseUI", "Comm.Channel") end BaseUI.updateVitals() BaseUI.createChatTriggers() if BaseUI.container then BaseUI.container:show() if not BaseUI.container.attached then BaseUI.container:attachToBorder("right") end BaseUI.checkMapData() cecho("\n[ Mudlet UI ] Shown.\n") else cecho("\n[ Mudlet UI ] It will appear as soon as the game sends chat or character data.\n") end end function BaseUI.alias(input) input = (input or ""):trim():lower() if input == "hide" then BaseUI.hide() elseif input == "show" then BaseUI.show() else local state if BaseUI.settings.hidden then state = "hidden" elseif BaseUI.container then state = "shown" else state = "waiting for game data" end cecho("\n[ Mudlet UI ] A starter interface built from your game's data (currently " .. state .. ").\n") cecho("[ Mudlet UI ] baseui hide - hide it (remembered between sessions)\n") cecho("[ Mudlet UI ] baseui show - bring it back\n") end end BaseUI.loadSettings() -- the chat triggers exist from the start (unless the UI is hidden) so the -- interface can appear on the first chat line even on games without GMCP BaseUI.createChatTriggers() registerAnonymousEventHandler("gmcp.Char.Vitals", "BaseUI.updateVitals") registerAnonymousEventHandler("gmcp.char.vitals", "BaseUI.updateVitals") registerAnonymousEventHandler("gmcp.Char.Maxstats", "BaseUI.updateVitals") registerAnonymousEventHandler("gmcp.char.maxstats", "BaseUI.updateVitals") registerAnonymousEventHandler("gmcp.Char.Status", "BaseUI.updateVitals") registerAnonymousEventHandler("gmcp.char.status", "BaseUI.updateVitals") registerAnonymousEventHandler("gmcp.Comm.Channel.Text", "BaseUI.addChatMessage") registerAnonymousEventHandler("sysProtocolEnabled", "BaseUI.enableChannelCapture") registerAnonymousEventHandler("mapOpenEvent", "BaseUI.checkMapData") registerAnonymousEventHandler("sysMapDownloadEvent", "BaseUI.checkMapData") registerAnonymousEventHandler("sysMapAreaChanged", "BaseUI.checkMapData") registerAnonymousEventHandler("gmcp.Room.Info", "BaseUI.checkMapData") registerAnonymousEventHandler("gmcp.room.info", "BaseUI.checkMapData")
